about: Perform Rayman’s signature punch and helicopter hair glide through colorful worlds, from the Dream Forest and its unforgettable mosquito ride to Band Land’s musical chaos. Rescue the Electoons and save the world from Mr.
Dark in a classic platforming adventure that remains as magical today as it was in the 90s.

Play the classic adventure across 5 versions (MS-DOS, PlayStation®, Atari Jaguar, GBC, and GBA) now enhanced with an immersive, reimagined soundtrack, plus more than 120 additional levels from Rayman’s New Levels, Rayman 60 Levels, and Rayman…
And for the first time ever, experience the long-lost SNES prototype, offering a rare glimpse into how Rayman’s innovative gameplay first took shape.
